events.name: ypy:dev:message
events.description: Fired by the development extension for every message it writes to the console (an error with context, a warning for incorrect or legacy use, a reload, a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE cut by `ypy-sync` as `sync-aborted` or `sync-dropped`, a 401, 403 or 419 as `status-401` and the like with `auth: true`). `code` is a stable name, `text` the sentence; other keys depend on the code (`ctx`, `selector`, `status`, `attribute`, `suggestion`, `guide`).

config.name: dev
config.description: Options of the development extension `ypy-dev`; `false` turns it off.

config.name: dev.latency
config.description: Simulated latency in milliseconds, or `[min, max]` (the JSON form of the tag). Off by default.

config.name: dev.offline
config.description: Start with the simulated offline state on.

config.name: dev.reload
config.description: Reload the page when a template changes: `true` listens on `/__ypy/reload`, a string is the URL of the Server-Sent Events endpoint.

config.name: dev.lint
config.description: `false` turns the markup and legacy warnings off.

config.name: dev.log
config.description: `false` keeps the console quiet; messages are still recorded and fired as `ypy:dev:message`.

config.name: dev.overlay
config.description: Show a panel with the status, the URL, the start of the response and the element when a request fails; Esc closes it. On by default only on a development host (`localhost`, `127.*`, `[::1]`, `*.local`, `*.test`, `*.localhost`).

config.name: dev.docs
config.description: Base URL of the guide pages that the legacy warnings link to.
